## Overview

Mirror https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60062 for the Rust frontend: carry `reasoning_ended` and `reasoning_parser_kwargs` through `/v1/chat/completions/render` → `/inference/v1/generate`, so the engine gates structured outputs the same way as on `/v1/chat/completions`.

## Claims

- `/inference/v1/generate` accepts `reasoning_ended` and `reasoning_parser_kwargs` and forwards them to the engine. Previously both landed in the flattened `other` map and were silently dropped, including when the request came from the Python `/render`.
- `reasoning_parser_kwargs` is typed (`chat_template_kwargs` only), so clients cannot pass arbitrary engine-side parser constructor kwargs: the engine receives only what Rust re-serializes.
- `/v1/chat/completions/render` emits the values the Rust chat route sends to the engine: `reasoning_ended` from the parser-built output grammar and the effective chat template kwargs. Completion render emits neither.

## Validation

From `rust/`:

```sh
cargo nextest run --locked -p vllm-server -p vllm-engine-core-client -p vllm-chat -p vllm-llm -p vllm-text
cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo fmt --check
```

1096 tests passed. New and updated coverage:

- `prepare_generate_request_forwards_reasoning_controls`: omitted, `reasoning_ended=false` with kwargs, and `reasoning_ended=true` with empty kwargs lower to the expected `TextRequest` fields.
- `render_chat_response_can_be_submitted_to_generate_unchanged`: the render output carries `chat_template_kwargs`, and the mock engine receives them in `EngineCoreRequest.reasoning_parser_kwargs` after submitting the render output unchanged to generate.
- `render_completion_returns_generate_request_with_body_request_id`: completion render omits both fields.

No real-model validation yet; this is a draft.

## Details

Not duplicating an open PR: the open gRPC counterpart https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/59836 changes the gRPC `Generate` API, not the HTTP route.

- The route reuses `ReasoningParserKwargs`, the engine-core protocol type that is already the `TextRequest` field type, adding only a serde default for `chat_template_kwargs` so `{}` is accepted like Python's `default_factory=dict`. Unknown keys are ignored rather than rejected, consistent with the rest of this request type (unknown top-level fields go to the ignored `other` map); unlike Python's `model_dump()`, they cannot reach the engine.
- Render omits `reasoning_parser_kwargs` when it equals the default. Generate maps an omitted value to the default, which is what the Rust chat and completion routes send today, so omission is lossless.
- Rust chat does not yet resolve `reasoning_ended=true` for `include_reasoning=false` as Python does; render reproduces whatever the Rust chat route sends, so that gap is unchanged here.

detail.body:
## Overview

Mirror https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60062 for the Rust frontend: carry `reasoning_ended` and `reasoning_parser_kwargs` through `/v1/chat/completions/render` → `/inference/v1/generate`, so the engine gates structured outputs the same way as on `/v1/chat/completions`.

## Claims

- `/inference/v1/generate` accepts `reasoning_ended` and `reasoning_parser_kwargs` and forwards them to the engine. Previously both landed in the flattened `other` map and were silently dropped, including when the request came from the Python `/render`.
- `reasoning_parser_kwargs` is typed (`chat_template_kwargs` only), so clients cannot pass arbitrary engine-side parser constructor kwargs: the engine receives only what Rust re-serializes.
- `/v1/chat/completions/render` emits the values the Rust chat route sends to the engine: `reasoning_ended` from the parser-built output grammar and the effective chat template kwargs. Completion render emits neither.

## Validation

From `rust/`:

```sh
cargo nextest run --locked -p vllm-server -p vllm-engine-core-client -p vllm-chat -p vllm-llm -p vllm-text
cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo fmt --check
```

1096 tests passed. New and updated coverage:

- `prepare_generate_request_forwards_reasoning_controls`: omitted, `reasoning_ended=false` with kwargs, and `reasoning_ended=true` with empty kwargs lower to the expected `TextRequest` fields.
- `render_chat_response_can_be_submitted_to_generate_unchanged`: the render output carries `chat_template_kwargs`, and the mock engine receives them in `EngineCoreRequest.reasoning_parser_kwargs` after submitting the render output unchanged to generate.
- `render_completion_returns_generate_request_with_body_request_id`: completion render omits both fields.

No real-model validation yet; this is a draft.

## Details

Not duplicating an open PR: the open gRPC counterpart https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/59836 changes the gRPC `Generate` API, not the HTTP route.

- The route reuses `ReasoningParserKwargs`, the engine-core protocol type that is already the `TextRequest` field type, adding only a serde default for `chat_template_kwargs` so `{}` is accepted like Python's `default_factory=dict`. Unknown keys are ignored rather than rejected, consistent with the rest of this request type (unknown top-level fields go to the ignored `other` map); unlike Python's `model_dump()`, they cannot reach the engine.
- Render omits `reasoning_parser_kwargs` when it equals the default. Generate maps an omitted value to the default, which is what the Rust chat and completion routes send today, so omission is lossless.
- Rust chat does not yet resolve `reasoning_ended=true` for `include_reasoning=false` as Python does; render reproduces whatever the Rust chat route sends, so that gap is unchanged here.
